# The born-suspended e2e arm double-clicks a cell the pool is still re-slotting

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingPooling.spec.mjs` › `an edit born suspended on a locked column that cannot suspend is embodied, not cancelled` merged today with #18898. Under a 12-worker mixed stress run (`--repeat-each=25`, together with the suspended-Tab spec) it failed 3 of 25 and 2 of 25, always at its first step: `editingIn(page, 'c38', recordId)` stayed false.

## The Problem

The failing page snapshot shows a focused editor holding `r3c32`: the double-click aimed at the cell rendering `c38` opened the editor on `c32`. The arm jumps the horizontal scrollbar to the far end, waits for the `c38` cell to be visible and for the body's `isScrolling` to be false, then double-clicks. `isScrolling: false` is not "the last render of that jump has landed": the pool re-slots cells once more, and the pointer gesture lands on a slot that renders another column by then.

The arm is about a session born suspended on a locked column; how its first edit is activated is incidental.

## The Architectural Reality

- Pooled cells: a DOM node is a slot, and the column it renders changes with the mounted column window (`grid.Body`, `mountedColumns`).
- `selection.grid.CellModel` is logical (`view.getLogicalCellId(record, dataField)`), and Enter on the View edits the SELECTED cell (`grid.plugin.CellEditing#editSelectedCell`) — no pointer position involved.

## The Fix

Activate by selection plus Enter: click the `c38` cell inside a `toPass()` retry until that cell carries `neo-selected`, then press Enter. Measured under the same stress: 25 of 25.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The arm passes 25 of 25 under `--workers=12 --repeat-each=25` next to the suspended-Tab spec; mutation P3 (`wasEmbodied` dropped) still reddens it.

## Out of Scope

- Whether a real user can hit the same thing (a double-click within a frame or two of a scroll jump editing a neighbouring column): sent as a defect-note, unproven — a render landing under the pointer and a worker-side slot mapping ahead of the DOM look the same from the arm.
- `KeyboardNavigationScroll.spec.mjs:40` (one CI sighting, 1 of 30 locally, not reproduced since).
